purpose: Machine-readable fail-closed dependency contract for the finite Parking Remaster gate registry. This contract authorizes nothing; it only prevents downstream activation before prerequisites pass.

human_boundaries.P1-006: Physical-iPhone V7.3 listening/feel judgment is required before PASS.
human_boundaries.P1-007: Single-car core-fun acceptance remains a Human-quality gate; CI cannot substitute for acceptance.
human_boundaries.P1-009: Fresh-player target-iPhone evidence is required; solver/runtime parity alone cannot PASS the gate.
human_boundaries.P2-002: Fresh external-player greenlight is required before production scaling.

forbidden_automatic_implications: P1-006 technical/browser evidence does not imply P1-006 PASS.
P1-007 prerequisite preparation does not authorize P1-008 implementation.
Legacy Level 1/2 parity does not authorize P1-009 or Level 3.
CI/numeric PASS does not imply Human gameplay-quality PASS.
